gloss: for a while; briefly; for the time being

definitions.explanation: A formal or literary adverb meaning for a short period of time. Used in written language and formal speech, often in official announcements or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: {暫時|ざんじ}お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{暫時|ざんじ}⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting will take a brief recess.

examples.japanese: {暫時|ざんじ}⟦{沈黙|ちんもく}→沈黙：13249_chinmoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: After a brief silence, the chairperson spoke up.

notes:
A formal, literary adverb meaning "for a while" or "briefly." Composed of {暫|ざん} (temporary, for now) and ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (time). Common in parliamentary proceedings, formal announcements, and literary prose. Rarely used in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暫時|ざんじ}⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧: brief recess
- {暫時|ざんじ}お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please wait a moment (very formal)
- {暫時|ざんじ}⟦{中断|ちゅうだん}→中断：05218_chuudan⟧: temporary suspension

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧: for a while — the standard everyday word; much more common in speech
- {暫|しばら}く: same word as above in kanji form
- ⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧: temporarily — focuses on something being provisional rather than on duration
- ⟦{当面|とうめん}→当面：07579_toumen⟧: for the time being — emphasizes the immediate future rather than a short pause
